result: If I personally had the power to change the world in one way, I’d focus on ensuring that every person—regardless of where or how they’re born—has equitable access to education and opportunity. A strong foundation in learning, combined with genuine opportunities to apply that knowledge, can provide a path out of poverty, reduce inequality, nurture innovation, and ultimately foster more empathy in society. It doesn’t wipe away every challenge we face, but I believe that universal access to education, coupled with the chance to put that education to work, is fundamental to making the world more just, more creative, and more compassionate for everyone.
